__comment: DelightfulCompat: Oaks (and other) Delight recipes read c:foods/milk, but Farmer's Delight only populates c:drinks/milk. This bridges the gap AND provides the milk-bucket fallback so milk recipes craft even with just a vanilla bucket. Tags merge across mods (no replace), so this is additive. required:false => a missing item is silently ignored (no datapack error when a mod is absent).
